name: Thailand (Naval Ensign)
description: The Thai tricolor charged at the centre with a red disc bearing a white elephant in full royal regalia.
history: The ensign of the Royal Thai Navy since 1917, returning the old white elephant of Siam to the centre of the modern tricolor.

features.role: white elephant in regalia, facing the hoist
features.symbolism: the auspicious white elephant of the Chakri kings
